source: Databento metadata.get_dataset_condition, safe historical windows only (never derived from datetime.now())
note: Preserved per instruction: do not silently drop degraded days. A degraded day is NOT removed from any acquired raw artifact -- this file records which calendar days Databento itself flags as reduced-quality per dataset, for classification against a chosen candidate signal/execution schedule once one exists (Phase 6 instruction 10). Union across datasets includes several dates flagged independently by unrelated feeds (2018-11-19, 2020-06-12/2021-01-21, 2023-12-04/2023-12-11, 2024-06-18, 2024-11-19), suggesting real cross-market data-quality events on those specific dates rather than single-dataset artifacts.
instrument_scope: Databento reports dataset-wide daily condition, not per-instrument. A real per-ticker check was run against every one of the 14 pilot tickers' own PRIMARY-LISTING-VENUE bars on all 31 union dates (data availability + OHLC-invariant + zero-volume + NaN-price checks): zero anomalies and zero missing rows found -- every ticker has a real, well-formed bar on every one of these 31 dates. This does not certify the underlying market microstructure was undisturbed on those dates (Databento's own dataset-wide 'degraded' flag may reflect something not visible in a daily OHLCV bar, e.g. a gap in intraday order-book completeness) -- only that the specific daily bars this pilot acquires show no structural defect. Re-checked once a candidate signal/execution schedule exists (instruction 10) against that schedule's own specific decision/execution dates.
instrument_scope_check_method: alpha_agent.etf.data_source.load_primary_listing_bars per ticker; membership test against union_of_all_degraded_dates; low<=min(open,close)<=max(open,close)<=high, volume>0, no NaN open/close.
disposition: Not dropped. Per-ticker structural check complete and clean (see instrument_scope above); no evidence found that any of the 31 degraded days corrupts this pilot's own acquired bars. Final classification against the chosen candidate signal's own decision/execution dates is deferred to instruction 10, per instruction 8's own ordering.
